thread:
Sam (Sales): Team — Acme POC hit 429s on embeddings; demo at 9am blocked, need triage.
Maya (SE): Logs from tenant acme-001: lots of tiny parallel embedding calls (~30–80 tokens) then 429s.
Maya (SE): Response headers: x-rate-limit-remaining:0, x-rate-limit-reset:18, x-burst-window-remaining:0.
Chris (SRE): Route is /v1/embeddings; appears per-route token bucket + short burst window. High concurrency empties burst.
Julien (Eng): We intentionally keep burst small to protect multi-tenant capacity; small requests are expensive due to overhead.
Sam (Sales): Customer wants a temporary lift for demo. Can we do a quick fix?
Tara (Acct Exec): We can grant a 1-hour courtesy bump if CS approves; billing will reflect any extra usage otherwise.
Chris (SRE): I can apply a temporary tenant-level burst bump for acme-001 for 3600s. Need product signoff on max.
Julien (Eng): Two actions: (A) short bump, low risk; (B) recommend batching small payloads to lower token accounting.
Maya (SE): They also aren't setting X-Redwood-Request-Group — adding it lets our routing coalesce requests. Send them a snippet.
Sam (Sales): Ok will ask them to add header. Chris, please apply the 60m bump now.
quota-bot: applied temporary_burst_bump tenant=acme-001 duration=3600 issuer=chris.sre scope=/v1/embeddings new_burst=+12000
Chris (SRE): Done. Also lowered per-route concurrency cap 220->140 to smooth spikes.
Maya (SE): Re-ran their script after bump — no 429s across 8k embeds. :thumbsup:
Tara (Acct Exec): I'll note the courtesy bump and flag billing for transparency.
Julien (Eng): For medium-term: propose POC rule-set with slightly larger burst window and an auto-suggest to batch client calls. I'll draft RFC.
Sam (Sales): Follow-ups: 1) Ask customer to add header + batch, 2) confirm demo success then revert bump.
Maya (SE): Sending header + sample: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Request-Group: acme-demo-1" -d '{"input":["t1","t2"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Chris (SRE): If they continue high parallelism recommend Dedicated for predictable throughput — loop in account team.
Tara (Acct Exec): Will follow up post-demo.
Sam (Sales): Thanks all — closing after demo confirmation.
